//: The age rating questionnaire, answered once and kept in git. It was previously clicked through by hand in App Store Connect, where nothing recorded what was answered or why — and a wrong answer here is a rejection, not a warning. Every content descriptor is NONE: the app is 88 line drawings of weather, animals, food and vehicles, with no text, no characters and no narrative. deliver reads this via app_rating_config_path.
//behaviour: The booleans are the ones that actually decide whether Apple treats this as a children's app, and every one of them is the reason the listing can honestly say what it says. They match the App Review reply and PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy word for word — if one of these ever changes, all three change together.
//kidsAgeBand: Deliberately absent. Setting it is what puts an app in the Kids category, and the Deliverfile explains at length why this one stays out of it: the Kids category forbids third-party data collection without verifiable parental consent, and this app ships Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics. Adding a kidsAgeBand here would silently contradict that decision and make the analytics a violation.
